A layout-table row keeps an image as Markdown instead of degrading it to alt text

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"
)

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<table><tr><td><img src="a.svg" alt="A"> <a href="/1">x</a></td><td><a href="/2">y</a></td></tr><tr><td><a href="/3">z</a></td></tr></table>`, &options)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Content)
}
```
